title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.
